note: One dataset carries the film: the average wait (4.2 days), the same wait split into hours (52 + 31 + 12 + 6 = 101 h), then its spread across requests. Replace every figure with yours and keep them consistent: the same label always shows the same value. Charts fill the frame without headings; a narration-cued note (chart.note) says what to look at. The queue opening is a world, not data: keep it or draw your own.
